# Gde sa psom

> Gde sa psom (www.gdesapsom.com) is a free Serbian directory of places where dogs are welcome: pet-friendly cafés, restaurants, bars and stays, dog parks, veterinary clinics, pet shops and dog food, in Belgrade, Novi Sad, Niš and across Serbia. Every place lists which dog sizes it accepts and whether it has a garden. Places are added by dog owners and reviewed by the team before they are published; rules for pets can change, so visitors are asked to check with the place before a visit. Free for visitors and for businesses, no sign-up.

The site is in Serbian (Latin script); an English version switches in place on the same URLs. Canonical host: https://www.gdesapsom.com. Each place has its own page at /spots/{id}.

## Directory

- [Pet-friendly places in Serbia](https://www.gdesapsom.com/all-spots): every café, restaurant, bar and stay, with search by name, city, dog size and type
- [Pet friendly Beograd](https://www.gdesapsom.com/beograd): cafés, restaurants, bars and stays in Belgrade that welcome dogs
- [Pet friendly Novi Sad](https://www.gdesapsom.com/novi-sad): the same for Novi Sad
- [Pet friendly Niš](https://www.gdesapsom.com/nis): the same for Niš
- [Pet friendly kafići](https://www.gdesapsom.com/kafici): cafés that welcome dogs
- [Pet friendly restorani](https://www.gdesapsom.com/restorani): restaurants that welcome dogs
- [Pet friendly barovi i pabovi](https://www.gdesapsom.com/barovi): bars and pubs that welcome dogs
- [Pet friendly smeštaj](https://www.gdesapsom.com/smestaj): hotels, apartments and other stays that accept dogs
- [Parkovi za pse](https://www.gdesapsom.com/pet-parks): dog parks and fenced dog areas
- [Veterinarske ambulante](https://www.gdesapsom.com/vet-clinics): veterinary clinics with address and phone
- [Prodavnice za ljubimce](https://www.gdesapsom.com/pet-shops): pet shops, delivery and the dog food they sell
- [Hrana za pse](https://www.gdesapsom.com/dog-food): dog food catalogue with prices and where to buy

## Guides

- [Putovanje sa psom u inostranstvo](https://www.gdesapsom.com/putovanje-sa-psom): what a dog from Serbia needs for a trip abroad (EU and neighbouring countries, each rule with its official source and the date it was checked, deadlines worked out from the travel dates) and a trip cost planner with comparison of options; in Serbian and English
- [Blog](https://www.gdesapsom.com/blog): advice on dog care, feeding and training, and travelling with a dog
- [Nova EU pravila za putovanje sa psom](https://www.gdesapsom.com/blog/nova-eu-pravila-putovanje-pas-april-2026): EU entry rules for dogs travelling from Serbia
- [How to travel to Serbia with a dog](https://www.gdesapsom.com/blog/how-to-travel-to-serbia-with-a-dog): entry requirements and documents, in English

## About

- [O nama](https://www.gdesapsom.com/about-us): who runs the directory and how places are added and checked
- [Za biznise](https://www.gdesapsom.com/for-business): how a café, restaurant or stay gets listed (free)
- [Politika privatnosti](https://www.gdesapsom.com/privacy-policy): what the site and the Android app collect
